ai.overviewSubtitle: Manage Gemini API keys, official transparent AI Agents, human-reviewed content publishing, multilingual SEO translations, and strict cost & emergency safeguards.
ai.emergencyStopConfirmDesc: Emergency Stop immediately halts all automated AI generation, scheduled publishing, translations, and assistant replies at the backend level.
ai.setupRequiredTitle: No Gemini API credentials configured yet

ai.noUsageYet: No Gemini API requests recorded yet.
ai.credentialsTitle: Gemini API Credentials, Model Registry & Shared Quota
ai.credentialsSubtitle: Store unlimited encrypted API keys grouped by Google Cloud Project ID. Keys in the same Project share RPM/TPM/RPD quota and never rotate to bypass limits.
ai.apiKeyLabel: API Key (Encrypted at rest, never displayed again)
ai.encryptionNote: Encrypted via Laravel Crypt (APP_KEY), sent strictly via x-goog-api-key header, never logged or returned in plaintext.
ai.sharedQuotaDesc: Tracks real per-minute and daily consumption per Project ID + Model. Exhausted windows enter waiting_for_quota instead of rotating keys to evade limits.
ai.deleteCredentialDesc: This permanently deletes the encrypted API key record. Existing usage logs remain preserved.
ai.agentsTitle: Official AI Agents & Versioned Prompt Library
ai.agentsSubtitle: Official AI Agents use standard user accounts with account_type=ai_agent, transparent AI badges, zero admin rights, and are excluded from real Human DAU/MAU.

ai.moderationAssistantDesc: Classifies safety risk and suggests moderation actions. Human moderators always make final ban/delete decisions.

faq.title: Sıkça Sorulan Sorular
faq.q1: SyncViet kullanmak için ödeme yapmam gerekiyor mu?
faq.a1: Hayır. Gönderi paylaşmak, yorum yapmak, tepki vermek, takip etmek, mesajlaşmak ve topluluklara katılmak tamamen ücretsizdir.
faq.q2: SyncViet Premium rozeti Kimlik Doğrulama ile aynı şey mi?
faq.a2: Hayır. Mavi onay işareti aktif ücretli bir SyncViet Premium üyeliğini gösterir. Kimlik doğrulama ve personel rozetleri tamamen ayrıdır.
faq.q3: Süresi dolmadan önce Premium planımı uzatırsam ne olur?
